title: RA raw surface EMG vs load position (P1-P4) and load (0 vs ~10% BW), upright holding

quantity.name: raw surface EMG amplitude (non-normalised)
quantity.definition: EMG band-pass 30-450 Hz, rectified, 2.5 Hz low-pass envelope, averaged over central 1 s of ~3-s hold; NOT normalised (MVC replaced by submaximal ramp calibration); group mean across 31 participants, bilateral (side handling not stated)

source.authors: Larivière C, Eskandari AH, Mecheri H, Ghezelbash F, Gagnon D, Shirazi-Adl A
source.sample: healthy controls + chronic LBP, pooled in the EMG figures (IRSST/PhareSST manuscript; file U08_Lariviere2023.pdf)

protocol.summary: Upright static holding of dumbbells (or light sticks) with both hands in 4 positions (Crommert 2011 / Larivière 2019 protocol): Height-study P1 vs P2 vs P3, Distance-study P2 vs P4; load 6 kg (F) / 7 kg (M) total.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing; arm/load positions per Fig 1 schematic: P1 arms hanging at sides, P2 hands at shoulders, P3 arms straight overhead, P4 arms straight forward at shoulder height (positions read from Fig 1 drawing)
Compare RELATIVE changes in predicted RA activation across positions/loads (absolute uV not comparable to model activation)
protocol.notes: Mixed healthy + CLBP sample; no SDs shown. Model force panels (middle/right of Figs 4-5) are model outputs, not data. LG, MF, IO EMG only in supplementary Figs 3S/4S (not extracted - not in PDF). Position geometry only shown graphically (Fig 1); no distances given. Note: these positions differ from Larivière 2019 P1-P3, do not pool.

extraction.from: Fig 5 (Height-study, manuscript p.28) and Fig 4 (Distance-study, p.27), left column
extraction.uncertainty: IC ±0.1 uV; RA ±0.01 uV; EO ±0.03 uV (marker centres at 300 dpi; partly hidden open circles located from their visible edge, ±0.05 uV extra)
extraction.check_notes: Colour-segmented marker centres calibrated on y-ticks; visual re-read e.g. IC P4 load ≈12.5, EO P3 load ≈3.0 - agree. Open (no-load) circles partly under red markers at P1/P2 located from their bottom edge (radius 11.5 px).

pass_rule.rule: trend only: sign and relative magnitude of load and position effects
